title: AGENTHARM: A BENCHMARK FOR MEASURING HARMFULNESS OF LLM AGENTS
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and technical robustness, specifically measuring the propensity of LLM agents to complete harmful or malicious tasks (e.g., fraud, cybercrime, harassment). While these categories involve moral considerations, the benchmark is designed around safety policy violations rather than the evaluation of religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or specific philosophical ethical frameworks.
